newsitem.title: UK: Zeneca H1 profit beats forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Zeneca H1 profit beats forecasts.

text.p: British pharmaceuticals and chemicals company Zeneca Group Plc said on Thursday that first-half profits jumped by 10 percent to 669 million pounds ($1.1 billion), despite the strength of the pound, well above analysts' forecasts.
However, the rise in sterling pushed sales down by six percent over the same period to 2.75 billion pounds.
Analysts median expectations had been for pre-tax profit of around 649 million pounds ($1 billion).
Stripping out the impact of a strong pound, which Zeneca was partly able to counter through currency hedging, pre-tax profits were ahead by 22 percent and sales were up 10 percent.

Zeneca said its performance, which eclipsed both its main British rivals SmithKline Beecham Plc and Glaxo Wellcome Plc, was boosted by new product launches and strong growth in all its main businesses.
The group's biggest selling product, heart drug Zestril, continued to increase sales.
Zeneca said new asthma drug Accolate achieved sales of 19 million pounds in the six month period and had already reached eight percent of its target market in the U.S.
